none: PAS FindID 997127: Lin-769CA4: Roman nummus of Helena
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Helena (AD 324-341), dating to the period AD 337-341 (Reece Period 17), Gloria Exercitus reverse type. Worn. Obverse description: Draped bust right. Obverse inscription: [FL IVL HE-L]ENAE [AVG]. Reverse description: Two soldiers holding one standard. Reverse inscription: [GLORI-A E]XER[CITVS]. Coin measures: 14.51 mm in diameter, 1.63 mm in thickness, and 1.34g in weight
